Use my few remaining reach credits today to post another bold prediction for $DAG and allow everyone to save and bookmark it.

All the accounts that spent most of 2025 dismissing positive developments from @Conste11ation will now start to flip-flop on their positions.

They spread FUD to keep the price low, allowing them to accumulate as much as possible while lowering their average buy price.

Plenty of substantive updates were posted last year, most of which these accounts dismissed.

I was the first—and one of only a handful of accounts—to post the news about HGTP being included in a document taught at the Army War College (Beyond DOTMLPF-P: A New Human-Machine Integration Paradigm by 2040).

We now know the United Nations will release a report highlighting the Iron SPIDR (HGTP for military) aviation logistics use case on March 3, 2026.

In 2025, it was revealed that the Panasonic use case being tested involved securing data from EMS vehicles (police, ambulance, and fire trucks), and this will continue to scale in 2026.

Digital Evidence went live, removing nearly all friction for businesses implementing blockchain via a simple API plug-in that puts data on chain. 

One of the first businesses to use it was TEMTRACE, a telecom expense management company with existing Fortune 500 customers, including the 5th largest hospital network in the United States (Lifepoint Health).

The UpsiderAI Metagraph went live and is already building an AI Agent Swarm that includes a Sports Bot and Retail Bot.

DôR Technology is still the only DePIN, to my knowledge, currently being used and deployed by the Federal Government (DTMs are in over 50 Army Museums nationwide). DôR also implemented 'The Retail AI' last year, which is part of the Upsider bot swarm, and stores are already benefiting from the insights and analytics it provides.

Real Estate Ledger went live last year and is already putting data on chain, including a $20M townhome development in Georgia.

DFNN is using HGTP to tokenize the national lottery in the Philippines and is the World's First Blockchain and Crypto-Integrated National Lottery. In the Philippines, the lottery comprises over 45% of all gaming revenue while the Asia-Pacific region dominates the global lottery with a 38% market share, but this is more than just a lottery app and will cover gaming, payments, and various exchange systems.

All of this and much more makes 2026 a breakout year for $DAG, and we will see more and more fair-weather fans changing their tune.

Last reminder: YES, THIS WILL BE ONE OF THE LARGEST REVENUE GENERATORS IN THE ENTIRE BLOCKCHAIN INDUSTRY.
